parsed.note_claim: Under UNCLOS Article 110, warships may board vessels suspected of being stateless, making the Tagor interception lawful.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Under Article 110 of UNCLOS, the reasonable suspicion of statelessness grants warships the Right of Visit.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the operation was executed based on UNCLOS Article 110 due to suspected statelessness and fraudulent flag registration.
